messages:
Maya: URGENT: LedgerPrime submitted an immediate preservation request. Deletion window for prefix `ledger/2024/Q4/**` in ~6h. They want a 180-day preservation, full audit export, and confirmation KMS key `key-b7f2` is usable. Who can take this?

Jonas: @Maya I can triage. Please post org_id and a couple of sample object keys + the emailed hold so Legal can log it.

Maya: Org_id: org_456. Examples: `ledger/2024/Q4/rec-0001.avro`, `ledger/2024/Q4/rec-0278.avro`. Customer forwarded signed hold email to legal@ just now.

Maya: They included a quick repro: DELETE returned 202 accepted but the object still fetches with GET.

Maya: ```bash
curl -i -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/ledger/2024/Q4/rec-0001.avro" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_YYY"
# HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
```

Maya: Then GET: `GET /v1/objects/ledger/2024/Q4/rec-0001.avro` -> 200 and content present.

Rhea: Expected behavior: deletes enqueue tombstone + async storage delete; search/index/CDN caches can still serve until reindex/invalidation. For a legal preservation we should: 1) set preservation flag for that prefix, 2) pause background reaper for the prefix, 3) snapshot objects to a secure export.

Jonas: I'll start the operational steps now:
- create preservation marker for `org_456:ledger/*`
- pause reaper for the prefix
- queue snapshot job (expedited)

ComplianceBot: Hold request recorded: LH-2026-333. Attach customer email to the record and confirm requested retention length.

Maya: Customer requested 180 days (they upgraded the ask). Email attached. Also they state the KMS key is customer-managed in eu-west-1: `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:444455556666:key/b7f2`.

Rhea: I'll validate KMS decrypt permissions before export. If the key policy blocks our export role we need customer to add decrypt. I can run a quick decrypt test on a small envelope. ETA ~45m.

Jonas: Pausing deletion worker for `org_456:ledger/*` now (expected ~10-15m). Snapshot job queued as `snap-19877` with expedited priority. Snapshot ETA depends on object count, but estimate 3-6h.

InfraBot: Deletion worker pause initiated for `org_456:ledger/*`. Snapshot job created: snap-19877 (priority: expedited).

Maya: Customer asked for delivery to our secure bucket with SSE-KMS and a signed manifest. Confirming that workflow is fine.

Jonas: We'll put export at `s3://redwood-legal-exports/ledger/org_456/LH-2026-333/` with SSE-KMS (redwood-managed) and include signed manifest + MD5/SHA256 checksums. If they insist, we can also do direct S3 into their bucket but only with a written agreement.

Rhea: KMS quick decrypt test -> SUCCESS. The export role has decrypt permissions. I'll produce `kms_key_report.txt` with key metadata and last-rotation timestamp.

ComplianceBot: Export ticket EX-6602 created and linked to incident INC-34901.

Jonas: Noted. Posting a customer-facing update: "Preservation applied and export queued. ETA ~4 hours. Hold ID LH-2026-333." Agree to send?

Maya: Send it. Also preemptively invalidated CDN/search cache for the prefix to reduce visibility leaks.

InfraBot: CDN invalidation queued: inv-4432 for `ledger/2024/Q4/*`. Expected propagation minutes.

InfraBot: Snapshot snap-19877 completed and moved to export stage. Export EX-6602 started. Delivery ETA ~2h.

Rhea: I'm extracting audit events and admin actions for org_456 into `audit_events.parquet`. Adding KMS usage logs and key access entries.

Maya: Customer now requests chain-of-custody manifest and a pre-signed URL for legal downloads (7-day expiry). We'll provide signed manifest and pre-signed link when upload finishes.

Jonas: Will include `manifest.jsonl` (signed), `objects.tar.gz`, `audit_events.parquet`, `kms_key_report.txt`, and checksums. Pre-signed URLs will be generated per file with 7-day expiry.

ComplianceBot: Export EX-6602 completed and archived under LH-2026-333 -> EX-6602. Files uploaded to `s3://redwood-legal-exports/ledger/org_456/LH-2026-333/export-6602/` with SSE-KMS. Pre-signed URLs generated for legal contacts.

Maya: Customer confirmed receipt and checksums matched. They asked to extend preservation beyond 180 days; Legal to review and respond.

Rhea: Runbook update: for preservation requests, validate customer KMS key before scheduling export, include `kms_key_report.txt` and `kms_usage.csv` in the export bundle, and always pause reaper + set preservation flags. Logged.

Jonas: INC-34901/EX-6602/LH-2026-333 remain open until legal confirms extension or expiry. Moving thread to watchlist.

Maya: Thanks team. Will update once Legal signs off. :white_check_mark:
